name: Angelique Tenkuu no Requiem
original_name: アンジェリーク 天空の鎮魂歌
source:
A RPG and direct sequel of the Angelique Special 2.


A powerful entity calling himself "the Emperor" invades the Sacred Bird Cosmos to conquer it for himself and imprisoned the Guardians and the Queen. Rosalia rushed to the Sacred Beast Cosmos, informing about the crisis and asked Collet for help. Collet, accompanied by Victor was sent by Rosalia to find and free the guardians while recruiting the rest of tutors and collaborators during Collet's Queen exam. 

On their journey, they met Arios, a wandering warrior who joined their journey to save the Sacred Bird Cosmos.
